questions.concept: Thread-scoped Agent generation loads and stores the exchange
questions.context:
Convex 1.41.0 and Agent 0.6.4. The Agent component is mounted and one thread starts empty. An Agent uses default context and storage options, no instructions or tools, and a local deterministic language-model stub that always replies "reply". Two separate actions run this line for the same thread, first with text "first", then "second". The stub does not store messages itself.

```ts
const result = await assistant.generateText(ctx, { threadId }, { prompt: text });
```
questions.question: What does the second model call receive, and what is stored afterward?

options.text: It receives only "second"; the thread stores both user/assistant exchanges.
options.rationale: The scoped Agent also loads recent thread context; saving is not its only automatic behavior.

options.text: It receives first, reply, second; the thread stores two user messages and two replies.
options.rationale: The scoped call loads the earlier exchange and persists the new prompt and generated reply.

options.text: It receives first, reply, second; the thread still stores only the first exchange.
options.rationale: Default storage persists the second exchange too; saveMessages:none is a separate control.

options.text: It receives first, reply, second; the first exchange is saved again alongside the new exchange.
options.rationale: Loaded context is not appended a second time as newly generated messages.
